name: SVC_FS_ACC_SCHED_HOURS
description: This table is used to store access schedule hours which are hours for each day of the week technicians are allowed to be on a customer site. This table and the SVC_FS_ACC_SCHED_OFFDAYS make up the access schedule defined in the SVC_FS_ACCESS_SCHEDULES table. SCHED_HOURS_ID is the primary / unique key in this table.

columns.name: SCHED_HOURS_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: ACC_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing SVC_FS_ACCESS_SCHEDULES (ACC_SCHEDULE_ID), the Access Schedule for these access hours.

columns.name: DAY_OF_WEEK_CD
columns.description: The day of the week the technician is allowed to be on the customer site for the working day.

columns.name: START_HOUR_SLOT_1
columns.description: The start hour for the primary access hours the technician is allowed to be on the customer site for the working day.

columns.name: END_HOUR_SLOT_1
columns.description: The end hour for the primary access hours the technician is allowed to be on the customer site for the working day.

columns.name: START_HOUR_SLOT_2
columns.description: The start hour for the additional access hours the technician is allowed to be on the customer site for the working day.

columns.name: END_HOUR_SLOT_2
columns.description: The end hour for the additional access hours the technician is allowed to be on the customer site for the working day.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the override type for these access hours, such as Add or Remove.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_SERVICE_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing SVC_SERVICE_PROFILES (SERVICE_PROFILE_ID), the service profile access hours that are overridden.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_WO_ID
columns.description: Foreign key referencing SVC_WORK_ORDERS (WO_ID), the Work Order that overrides the access hours for the combination of account, country and region.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments about the access schedule hours.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Property used to identify if specific access schedule hours are active.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
